notes.title: June Devlog
notes.content: [p]Happy June! Going on Vacation towards the end of this month so I'm getting the Devlog out a little earlier.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Updated Lighting[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/5983bef94372d9759b44a5973e6d7b720613ba9d.gif"][/img][/p][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/59592f7ba3c93b569f585ae0a6122133fea9d1ff.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/59592f7ba3c93b569f585ae0a6122133fea9d1ff.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p]Probably the biggest visual problem of current Gerascopia builds; the lighting engine.[/p][p][/p][p]It was hobbled together by displaying a bunch of tiles with different opacities, which caused a lot of visual problems, and affected performance pretty drastically. If youve had any performance problems in previous versions, this mightve been the reason.[/p][p][/p][p]This will also make certain areas with brighter backgrounds look a [b]lot[/b] better![/p][p][/p][h2]Updated Visual Effects[/h2][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/99f3c51b86fcfc283ee1f1a71305a9ca71df4777.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/99f3c51b86fcfc283ee1f1a71305a9ca71df4777.gif"][/img][/url][/p][p]Water, and other areas, will now give you more effects. Theyre meant to be as subtle as possible while still feeling like theyre there. [/p][p][/p][h2]Snake's Path[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/6626e3c1d7b68aa7061be3490b2de2134e806150.png"][/img][/p][p]An additional area that's being added to this update will act as a connector between each of the 4 main areas. The entrances may be closed, but once open, they will be open forever (unless, you delete your save file or something).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Additional Progression Information[/h2][p][url="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/39cac6928ed4426d9c80ef9b69058d9d9f03ad21.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/2fe3243b93cf34f91cfb514771c71a18d642baea.png"][/img][/url][/p][p]Most of this month has been dedicated to respriting a lot of old stuff. icons may look more polished and sprites have a new layer of paint.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm additionally working on adding a lot more puzzles in the newer areas. I'm suprised how little puzzles are in Gerascopia at the moment. Its either finding a hole in the wall or something so cryptic you need an insane amount of luck to find it.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, the scope of this update is going to be decently big, but I'm getting a vibe for when it might be out. im NOT giving you a date because my track record for release dates is very bad.[/p]

notes.title: 2 Year Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/3fb0322c3292f2da865fd5e08ce602aedd58d4c1.gif[/img]

Happy 2 year of GeraScopia! Im gonna get straight into the dev log.

I've changed my mind on a lot of previous changes I had planned, so I want to confirm what I'm going to and not going to do. Its a lot bigger of an update than I thought. Wordy stuff is at the end.

[h1]Content Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/8dc26fe8b4c93747ba5e6a9fb94e1fd27c53fbfc.png[/img]
It's Blue!

Outside of expanding [b]every current area[/b], I will be adding a couple new areas. At minimum I want to add at [b]least[/b] 4 new areas.

I will also be adding more detail to already existing areas, giving them more identifiable landmarks to prevent completely getting lost.

[h1]Updated Banner[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/8fa5f74a808aea617281f83808d0edf7e859fab7.png[/img]
When the update drops, I plan on updating the splash art of the game.


[h1]Animation Updates[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/17ac83c2cac36bba29f61ca37f1c084b5138714b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/12e0f93101a4c5a6874d566ae36fe6c69f7888a7.gif[/img]

The game is getting a slight artistic overhaul; nothing major, just updating some inconsistent sprites and designs. This will have no major effect on the game

[h1]Updated Mechanics[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/ecebdc244494199c192d261ae3f0505dbaf93ba8.gif[/img]
Outside of reworking certain tools (The torch being a main one), there will be more movement options in the newest update. 

[h1]Portrait Updates[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/f052e52f1e2aca09920a84318e7cc58ba733761e.gif[/img]

Alongside animation updates, major portraits will be getting an overhaul as well. I've grown a lot artistically in the past year and I want that to be reflective in the final state I leave GeraScopia in. 

[h1]Fishing Update[/h1]
The Fishing Minigame will be getting updated portraits, waves, and costumes.

[h1]MISC. Updates[/h1]
Gallery
More Monsters
New Random Rooms
New Endings
New Minigame

[h1]Word Salad DevLog[/h1]

Yoyoyo! This updates been a while in the making and honestly something I've spent too long thinking about. Originally, I was going to make a [b]sequel[/b] to GeraScopia, and a lot of this content would be put into that project. I reeled back eventually because I think the concept of "Gerascopia 2" mostly came from a financial drive, and now that my finances arent a huge problem (relatively for an artist lmao), I feel less inclined to create something like that. So, naturally, this update will be free. I will most likely drop the price of the game soon after the update as well. As the games life cycle sunsets I want to leave it as a very strong project that people may discover and revisit upon playing my newer titles. 

I'm bad at estimating release dates and how long the update will take to "beat". I'm confident in a 2025 release, and I hope the new update will at least be worth 2 of your afternoons, and maybe a referral to a friend(lol).

Additionally, Im not gonna add achievements, at least right now (Im great at changing my mind). If I do, there will not be many. Like 3 or 4. As much as GeraScopia is an "Achievement Hunter" game, I don't feel like thats the intent of the game, and you should be finished with it when you feel content.

I'll see you soon! Maybe!

notes.title: GERASCOPIA 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARRRRY
notes.content:
Gerascopia is Officially 1 Year old! Woohoo! Thanks for playing and supporting the project so far! I have a few more things up my sleeve for the game, and some general announcements.

[h3]Content Update[/h3]
I'm planning on adding final big content update later this year. This will be mostly centered around adding a large amount of random events, and a few other things. This will also add a Gallery, and Some Achievements (Yes... I'm doing it.), and secret stuff..... Its not going to be as big as "The Wrong Places", but it will make replays more unique.

You might be wondering why this isn't releasing today, and its mostly cause....

[h3]What I've been doing[/h3]

If you arent aware, I've made a new project: Blood Poker. Its a smaller project thats a very hypervisual poker/horror game. I'd check it out if you havent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/ff7235503d15240777515b4d21669e69f6c4ee5b.gif[/img]

Additionally. I've been developing another game: 52Beatup, and I need to finish it LOL. It's a Deck Building Fighting game, and Gera will be in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/d6c92343306d98ad89a6f36815252590cd050f4a.gif[/img]

So all in all to say, I have been very busy. And I've been wanting to do this update for a while, but it will have to wait.

Thanks for Reading! See you Soon!

notes.title: GERASCOPIA: THE WRONG PLACES UPDATE IS OUT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467413/240743e4125c009f54cb3a3bb90ae88aa64f3e0e.png[/img]

This is a Massive Update to Gerascopia, Adding 4 New Areas, Multiple QoL and Settings, More Endings. Etc. This will most likely be the last big update, thank you for playing and sticking with development.

The Patchnotes are Below:

[b]New Changes[/b]
	-Fishing Materials now show up in the menu when you get any of them.
	-Added 4 New Areas
	-Options are now available! You can change effects/volume/brightness
	-Game Settings are now available! You can change specific flags in the game that can alter or make exploring easier!
	-Added a new Ending
	-Controls! If you really dont like the P/O/SHIFT Layout, this is for you!
	-Controller Support! Its pretty light ATM and allows for mild adjustments. Tested on Dualshock.
	-Added multiple movement techniques
	-Added more critters
	-Added More Music Tracks
	-Adjusted Movement slightly
	-Added a new Ending
	-Adjusted Volumes of certain effects/creatures
	-The Chance to find a secret room has drastically increased
	-More secret rooms have been added
	-Adjusted chance of random sfx playing
	-Reduced Game Size
	-Improved General Performance Involving Effects and Darkness Code. This will most likely not be noticable but its worth mentioning.

[b]Bug Fixes (General)[/b]
	-Fixed bug where you could prompt the gun pickup animation but never get the gun
	-Fixed Audio bug where volume would jump incredibly high very fast (Im so sorry about that one LMAO)
	-Fixed bug involving using your gun on a wall
	-When dying, if you opened your menu up the menu would persist.
	-When dying, if you held a direction while dying, your momentum would persist.
	-Fixed a problem with the fullscreen option where Fullscreening would permenently change your minimum screen size and cause other applications to change size as well

[b]Fishing Minigame[/b]
	-Increased Input Leniency by 2 Frames

[b]Area 1 Changes[/b]
	-Fixed minor visual problems
	-Added a visual blockade in a particular spot that looked like you could slide through it
	-Adjusted the monsters AI Slightly [Barely Noticable but worth mentioning. its still a buggy mess]
	-Fixed visual error where the Fear state would last even after the monster stopped chasing you

[b]Area 2 Changes[/b]
	-Fixed multiple walls that could not be grabbed onto, specifically in the area with the monster.
	-Fixed bug where you could clip into the wall during the Monster chase
	-Fixed bug where a wall wasnt flush by like, half a pixel, so if you went into it on the right momentum you'd get stuck nd die to the guy
	-Fixed some visual problems with the water
	-Fixed bug where you could appear in front of the water object
	-Once escaping a chase, the monster will dissapear 250% faster
	-The monster can only kill you when the chase event happens. This has been implemented due to fringe cases where the monster
	would swim into you on accident without triggering a flag, causing an unfair death.

[b]Area 3 Changes[/b]
	-Reduced Volume of Area Themes
	-Fixed bug where sitting near the fireplace could crash the game under certain circumstances.
	-Fixed Audio bug where the music wouldnt transition in the Area 3 Savepoint to Atmospheric Music
[b]
Area 4 Changes[/b]
	-Increased Volume of Area Themes
	-Destroying the 4th orb now flashes the screen and tells you the door is open
	-Fixed bug where the game could crash after destroying the 4th orb

[b]Area 5 Changes[/b]
	-Adjusted what happens when you break both orbs in Area 2

[b]Area 6[/b]

[b]Area 7[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix + Speedrun Update V0.41
notes.content:
-Added a "Quick Reset" Mode that will make the game reset all values and give you a fresh start. This mode is accessible any point after you start a round, if you want a hard reset. THIS WILL REMOVE FISHING STUFF, LIKE CURRENCY AND IT BEING UNLOCKED.

	*If you accidentally click this option, the save will not occur until you pick up an item or get to an amulet post. 

[b]If you want to keep your old save, go to 
C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\Local\GeraScopia
and either rename data.txt, or save it somewhere else. If you ever want to play that save again, just rename it back to data.txt and put it in that file, overwriting your current save.[/b]

--Fishing--
-Fixed bug where both Fishing Bosses would bug out and stop using their rage attacks
-Fixed bug where fishing minigame wouldnt end
-Fools Catch now attacks slightly faster [120 frame cooldown -> 110 frame cooldown]
-A certain purchase that can be made in the fishing minigame has been drastically reduced (5,000,000G -> 2,500,000G)


unless anything big happens in the next bit, im gonna go silent on patches for a week or so, and come back with a pretty big update that adds a lotta hidden stuff! Thank so for supporting the game and sticking thru with it all.

notes.title: V0.4 Update
notes.content:
-Fixed An Issue Regarding Saving. If you would boot the game and then immediately close it without starting, the game would corrupt your saves.

-Added visual indicator on menu to show how to enable assist mode
-Fixed bug where the Alternate 3rd Monster would have a glitched sequence if you fell into the lake or didnt exactly follow her specific pathing. After she is on the ledge, if you leave to any other area, she will be waiting at the ledge in the camp room.
-The "SHIFT" prompt will no longer appear if you are in the 2nd area, as you cannot run underwater.
-Added in far more Amulet text prompts
-Monster 2's Chase Delay when He Notices you Slightly Increased [45 Frames -> 55 Frames]
-Monster 2's Acceleration to Max Speed Decreased Slightly [0.01 Unit Increase/Frame -> 0.008 Unit Increase/Frame]
-Monster 1 Will now slowly gain a speed penalty the more times you die, capping out at a 1.5 movement speed penalty, which is halved during the chase sequence, rounded up.
-Game will now correctly pause when its not in focus
-Area 1 Eggs now have a smaller proximity where they will start breaking, but running over them will make them break far faster
-Added more details in the Area 1 Chase segment to better help the player know where to go and to mentally mark locations
-Did Slight Pathing Adjustments for Area 1 Monster.
-Text Popups now appear for an additional second to help improve readability for slower readers
-Note list now displays the correct numbers. (i.e it now correctly displays 1/24 instead of 0/23 for the 1st note.)
-Added another ending
-the HUD will now prompt you when you're trying to equip a torch you're already holding.
-Picking up the gun now prompts you on how to aim AND fire.
-Monster 3's Stomping now has proximity for the screenshake and stepping sounds
-Monster 3 now has a visual effect where it will "bleed" progressively more as it gets hurt more and more

--Fishing Updates--
-Each hook now has unique effects
Judgement Carp now no longer increases style meter, and throws out less attacks. To Balance this, Judgement Carp will now deplete your entire Style Gauge to improve its damage and duration. Use it during a FFF ranking to clear the field!

-You can no longer change the momentum of your hook during panaque buster.
-Drastically increased the hitbox of the Panaque Buster hit. This should make it far more consistent.
-Hidden Status now goes away upon hitting an enemy, and provides a 500% damage bonus


For Next Patch:
-Speedrun mode/option
-A lot more random effects/interactions
-Bugs... of course!
-And more!

notes.title: Saving Bug Notice
notes.content:
It has come to my attention that there is a decently common chance that upon booting a new game, your game will create an incredibly weird save data and attempt to load from it, which causes large problems.

If you obtain the Gun within the first few rooms, the bug has happened for you. It will make it impossible to pick up torches and overall ruin the game experience if not fixed. 

As I work on ironing this bug out, the quickest solution is to locate your save data in:

C:\Users\[USER]\AppData\Local\GeraScopia

then delete data.txt, or any files in this folder. Reboot the game and it should work fine.

Apologies for the inconvenience as I fix this, I will hopefully have a patch out in the next 24 hours.
